turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. or Ms.? I don't know which, and nobody from this school called to tell me. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, so let's start with who decided that.
You asked, I came. Now, who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you a question about my son, and I'm still waiting for the answer.
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
If we were on the same team, someone would have picked up the phone before that zero went in. Who decided, and when?
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
Forward to what? I've asked you three times who decided on that zero, and I'm writing down that you haven't answered.
